name: synap402
description: Synap402 (by Linkrra): open-weight models (Qwen3 Coder, Qwen3, Qwen3 VL, Gemma 4, gpt-oss, Muse Glimmer) served on Linkrra's own GPUs behind an OpenAI-compatible API, billed per token. Every listed model supports tool calling and streaming. The same endpoint also accepts x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) for wallet-based pay-per-call access with no account or API key -- see the x402 note in README.md; goose's custom-provider mechanism itself only speaks the api_key_env route below.
setup_steps: Sign in at https://synap402.com/login.html and create an API key (qwen3-coder-30b has a free tier: 100,000 tokens/day for the first 7 days, then 50,000/day, no card needed)
Paste the key as LINKRRA_API_KEY (or export LINKRRA_API_KEY in your shell)
Pick a model: qwen3-coder-30b is the recommended default for coding sessions
